changes: Retain bounded clean dd --help capture without using advertised words as the execution capability gate.
Synthetic dd uses bs512, count3, skip2; exact output must equal the third512-byte block of the unchanged2048-byte input.
release_boundary: Root may run this exact bounded synthetic probe. The native count/skip behavior is not accepted until actual physical output proves the exact512-byte third block and unchanged input. A later header reader must bind that actual pass and use count=skip+1, with every fixed header read still bounded to512 bytes.
source_provenance_limit: The qualified custom native binary is pinned by bytes/hash and dependencies; its native build has not been reproduced. Upstream behavior is rationale for this controlled synthetic test, not a substitute for actual-binary evidence.
